orbit: group zeros by the functional-equation involution a=rho-1/2 maps to -a; retain one representative per plus/minus orbit with original zero multiplicity m
squared_product: Xi(y)/Xi(0)=product_[a modulo plus/minus](1-y^2/a^2)^m under symmetric Hadamard convergence
convergence: N(T)=O(T log T) implies sum_[orbits]m/|a|^2 converges, so the paired genus-zero product and logarithmic derivative converge locally uniformly away from poles
conjugation: off line, a and conjugate(a) are distinct plus/minus orbits and give conjugate lambda poles; on the critical line conjugate(a)=-a, so one positive ordinate represents the whole functional pair and is counted once with multiplicity m
completed_split: 1/s+1/(s-1) divided by 2y equals 1/(x-1/4); gamma/pi and zeta'/zeta retain their standard coefficients, and the zeta pole cancellation occurs only in their completed sum
acceptance_test: Attach authoritative references for the xi Hadamard product and zero-count estimate, then jointly audit this orbit convention against the endpoint-gamma-prime inverse Laplace formulas and all checker multiplicities.
